title: Gathering all three Feast of Wax toasts at Mootcombe (king's, Church's, guests') sets up the 'rite' resolution for the barred hall, but choosing the bargain instead (getting the three claimants to stand down) makes the toasts permanently decorative with no in-fiction acknowledgment that the alternate path is now moot — a completionist who collected all three has no way to know they won't be used.
